issue.title: [DocDB] Tablet may stuck on shutting down in case of errors during bootstrapping

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-9953](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-9953)
### Description

The user was complaining about the table is not completely deleted and there's one remaining tablet. Manual deletion failed with an error:
```
$ yb-ts-cli delete_tablet -force 2f03b94cbf464d05a298ebc31e592c69 "test"
Unable to delete tablet: IO error (yb/tools/ts-cli.cc:505): Failed to delete tablet: : code: TABLET_NOT_RUNNING status { code: ALREADY_PRESENT message: "State transition of tablet 2f03b94cbf464d05a298ebc31e592c69 already in progress: {2f03b94cbf464d05a298ebc31e592c69, opening tablet}" source_file: "../../src/yb/tserver/ts_tablet_manager.cc" source_line: 1617 errors: "\000" }
```
From the message and tablet report it was seen that the tablet had been stuck at the bootstrapping stage.
The following stack was observed in the threads dump:
```
Threads
 @ 0x7ffff66e300c __pthread_cond_wait
 @ 0x35cef9c yb::tablet::TransactionParticipant::Impl::StartS
 @ 0x353cd4f yb::tablet::Tablet::StartShutdown()
 @ 0x3532cf5 yb::tablet::Tablet::~Tablet()
 @ 0x3568c23 yb::tablet::TabletBootstrap::Bootstrap()
 @ 0x356531c yb::tablet::BootstrapTabletImpl()
 @ 0x357965b yb::tablet::BootstrapTablet()
 @ 0x374677d yb::tserver::TSTabletManager::OpenTablet()
 @ 0x3a7000d yb::ThreadPool::DispatchThread()
 @ 0x3a6b4f3 yb::Thread::SuperviseThread()
 @ 0x7ffff66de693 start_thread
 @ 0x7ffff6be041c __clone
```
